script_text: This week, the cosmos interrupts Libra routine with a New Moon and a Venus-driven shockwave. Early this week, Monday and Tuesday, the New Moon in your seventh house squares Mercury in your tenth, making partnership drama feel like career crisis. Wednesday brings Venus in your fifth house trine Sun in the tenth, igniting romance and creative risk. Venus, your ruling planet, Earth element. Midweek, the Moon in your second house squares Saturn in your twelfth, forcing old money wounds to surface. Late week, Venus enters your sixth house, aligning with your Sun in the fourth, turning chores into emotional healing. Weekend, Mars in your eighth house sextiles your Sun, deepening intimacy or financial trust. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your fifth house. Saturday is your worst day because Mars squares Venus in the sixth. Release imbalance before renegotiating. Follow for daily updates.
